subject: ESA-consistent F1 applicability for aggregate sectoral financial positions

historical_phase_B.rule: The Phase B/C/D evidence chain must continue to be interpreted under the contract that existed at the Phase B workflow head. A later methodological correction may not rewrite the preregistered experiment.

findings: F1 comprises monetary gold and SDRs.
Monetary gold is restricted to monetary-authority/international-financial-organisation asset positions and has no ordinary resident-sector counterpart liability.
SDRs are held by official holders; SDR allocation liabilities are recorded against the rest of the world rather than as ordinary H/C resident liabilities.
Therefore a future contract can justify a narrower structural-zero scope than the historical Phase B contract, but only prospectively.

H.basis: ESA 2010 confines monetary gold to monetary authorities/international financial organisations and SDRs to official holders. H/NPISH therefore has no F1 asset or liability in the RMD institutional boundary.

C.basis: ESA 2010 confines monetary gold to monetary authorities/international financial organisations and SDRs to official holders. S11 therefore has no F1 asset or liability.

F.basis: F is S12-S121. F1 assets must be removed explicitly from both S12 and S121. Resident F1 liabilities are structurally zero because monetary gold has no counterpart liability and SDR allocations are liabilities of the rest of the world.

G.basis: Central-government institutions can be monetary authorities under ESA 2010, so S13 F1 assets cannot be assumed zero. Resident F1 liabilities are structural zero under the monetary-gold/SDR recording rules.

BNR.basis: S121 F1 assets are in scope and must be removed explicitly. Resident F1 liabilities are structural zero; SDR allocation liability is recorded in the rest of world.

X.basis: Rest-of-world F1 can include the counterpart to monetary-authority transactions and SDR liabilities, so both W1 external sides are explicitly sourced.

proposed_future_construction.H: Use W0 S1M total F directly; F1 is structurally not applicable under the preregistered ESA rule.
proposed_future_construction.C: Use W0 S11 total F directly; F1 is structurally not applicable under the preregistered ESA rule.
proposed_future_construction.F: Assets: (W0 S12 F - W0 S12 F1) - (W0 S121 F - W0 S121 F1). Liabilities: W0 S12 F - W0 S121 F because resident F1 liabilities are structural zero.
proposed_future_construction.G: Assets: W0 S13 F - W0 S13 F1. Liabilities: W0 S13 F because resident F1 liabilities are structural zero.
proposed_future_construction.BNR: Assets: W0 S121 F - W0 S121 F1. Liabilities: W0 S121 F because resident F1 liabilities are structural zero.
proposed_future_construction.X: For W1 S1/S1, compute resident external F-F1 separately for A and L; set X assets = resident external liabilities and X liabilities = resident external assets.
proposed_future_construction.stock_and_flow: Apply the same exact identity independently to LE stocks and F financial transactions; never difference stocks to create flows.

structural_zero_scope.resident_F1_liabilities_for_F_G_BNR: ESA2010 monetary-gold no-counterpart-liability plus SDR liability recorded in rest of world

next_action.rule: The corrected-applicability run is retained as exploratory evidence only. Do not reinterpret historical A-D or tune F1 orientation/structural-zero rules from its residuals. Any future formal test requires a new independently preregistered phase before opening new source outcomes.
next_action.rationale: The exploratory run occurred after the original A-D outcomes and showed large reconciliation failures. Its scientific value is diagnostic; it does not authorize adaptive source remapping.
